blockingIssues.description: Unable to complete required fix review because Task subagent launches fail in this validator session. `Task(scrutiny-feature-reviewer)` and `Task(worker)` repeatedly exited with code 1; initial attempts reported `Invalid model: custom:GPT-5.3-codex`, and subsequent attempts (after switching validationWorkerModel and pinning reviewer droid to built-in models) still exited with no assistant message events.
blockingIssues.suggestedFix: Restore Task subagent launchability for validation sessions (model resolution / runtime startup), then rerun scrutiny so the fix feature can be reviewed by a reviewer subagent.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Document an explicit fallback path when Task-based reviewer subagents cannot launch (e.g. model-resolution failure), including whether manual review is permitted or whether the validator must fail fast with standardized synthesis output.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: This rerun was blocked after validators passed because all Task launches failed before producing reviewer output, leaving no procedural guidance beyond returning to orchestrator.

rejectedObservations.observation: Proceed with manual in-session review and mark scrutiny pass without spawning reviewer subagents.
rejectedObservations.reason: rejected: conflicts with scrutiny-validator required behavior (`spawn review subagents`) and would weaken validation guarantees.
